title: Axolotl wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points="50,8 38,32 62,32" fill="#ff4d88"/>
  <polygon points="50,8 44,20 56,20" fill="#ffcc00"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="4" fill="#00e5ff"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#00e5ff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#00e5ff"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="8" x2="38" y2="32" stroke="#ff4d88" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="8" x2="62" y2="32" stroke="#ff4d88" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="30" ry="20" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="24" ry="14" fill="#ffc0d8"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#ff9ec4"/>

  <!-- Gills left -->
  <path d="M28,40 Q14,30 10,44" stroke="#ff6fa3" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28,46 Q12,42 8,54" stroke="#ff6fa3" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28,52 Q14,54 12,64" stroke="#ff6fa3" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Gills right -->
  <path d="M72,40 Q86,30 90,44" stroke="#ff6fa3" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72,46 Q88,42 92,54" stroke="#ff6fa3" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72,52 Q86,54 88,64" stroke="#ff6fa3" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="46" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2e1a47"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="46" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2e1a47"/>
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="44" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57.5" cy="44" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="48" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="48" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="54" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#ff6fa3" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="54" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#ff6fa3" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Mouth smile -->
  <path d="M44,56 Q50,62 56,56" stroke="#d94f83" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Belly line -->
  <path d="M50,63 Q50,80 50,88" stroke="#ffc0d8" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Arms -->
  <path d="M24,68 Q18,74 22,80" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M76,68 Q82,74 78,80" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M50,90 Q40,94 34,92 Q42,88 50,88" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <path d="M50,88 Q44,92 38,90" stroke="#ffc0d8" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
</svg>
